title: 第二十五章 真相炼化迟到第二十六章 大哥看神仙
lines: 看到这里，王贤只觉得自己的脑袋瞬间要炸开了！
“嗖！”地站了起来！
这一刹那只觉得电闪雷鸣，石破天惊！
这一刹那，他记起了所有的往事......
原来一切，都是师兄在设计陷害自己，陷害自己毒杀书院同门，陷害自己毒杀他司马珏。
原来，这一切都是那父子两人的阴谋！
不仅害死了藏书楼的龙杰，还将自己绑在书院凤凰台的盘龙柱上......
“九百九十九剑！司马珏，你们父子刺了我九十九十九剑！啊......”
他虽然不明白为何会来到万里之外的昆仑，成了师父的弟子！
但是他好像有些明白，原来是盘龙柱化为了神剑，没入了自己的身体！
难怪，四大宗门的长老，都来昆仑南坡的云起道观，为神剑而来......
就在他欲要暴走的当下。
白衣女子伸手拉着他坐下，静静说道：“别激动，有话慢慢说！”
闻言，王贤不得不定下神来。
喃喃自语道：“前辈，那可恶的父子陷害我，更是将我绑在盘龙柱上，刺了我九百九十九剑！”
“好恶毒的父子啊！”
白衣女子幽幽一叹：“没想到一杯灵酒，跟一块无意中得到的玉璧，却让你恢复了记忆，真是不可思议。”
王贤也明白，他从来没有见过面前的白衣女子。
白衣女子也不知道他身体里的神剑，更不可能变出那曾经发生的一幕，来骗自己。
“好险！”
王贤冷冷地说道：“若不是师父，只怕我早就死了。”
女子抬头望天，说道：“苍天在上，或许他也想为你讨一个公道！”
王贤拱手回道：“多谢前辈，助我恢复记忆！”
白衣女子摇摇头：“你眼下的修为太弱了，让我助你一臂之力吧。”
说完，从王贤手里拿起这颗晶莹剔透的内丹，塞入他的口中。
还没等王贤反应过来，又端起玉杯倒上灵酒，灌进他嘴里。
王贤惊叫一声，只觉得一团燃烧的烈火，在胸中蔓延开来。
白衣女子抓着他的小手，沉声说道：“凝聚灵气，我助你炼化......”
王贤点点头，一股庞大的灵力，刹那往自己身体里涌入。
一声惊呼，王贤根本无法承受这滚滚而来的灵气。
content_en:
"Ah..."
Seeing this, Wang Xian felt like his head was going to explode instantly!
"Whoosh!" He stood up!
At this moment, I only felt lightning and thunder, which was earth-shattering!
At this moment, he remembered all the past events...
It turns out that everything was framed by his senior brother, who framed him for poisoning his fellow academy disciples, and framed himself for poisoning him, Sima Jue.
It turns out that all this was a conspiracy between the father and his son!
Not only did he kill Long Jie in the library, but he also tied himself to the dragon column on the Phoenix Terrace of the academy...
"Nine hundred and ninety-nine swords! Sima Jue, you and your son stabbed me ninety-nine times! Ah..."
Although he didn't understand why he came to Kunlun, thousands of miles away, and became his master's disciple!
But he seemed to understand that it turned out that the Panlong Pillar turned into a divine sword and submerged into his body!
No wonder, the elders of the four major sects all came to Yunqi Taoist Temple on the southern slope of Kunlun for the Divine Sword...
Just when he was about to go berserk.
The woman in white stretched out her hand and pulled him to sit down, and said quietly: "Don't get excited, speak slowly if you have anything to say!"
Hearing this, Wang Xian had to calm down.
He murmured to himself: "Senior, that abominable father and son framed me, tied me to a coiled dragon pillar, and stabbed me nine hundred and ninety-nine times!"
"What a vicious father and son!"
The woman in white sighed faintly: "I didn't expect that a cup of spiritual wine and a piece of jade that I accidentally obtained could restore your memory. It's really incredible."
Wang Xian also understood that he had never seen the woman in white before him.
The woman in white didn't know the divine sword in his body, and she couldn't possibly conjure up the scene that happened to deceive herself.
"What a risk!"
Wang Xian said coldly: "If it weren't for Master, I'm afraid I would have died long ago."
The woman looked up at the sky and said, "Heaven above, maybe he also wants to seek justice for you!"
Wang Xian cupped his hands and replied: "Thank you, senior, for helping me restore my memory!"
The woman in white shook her head: "Your current cultivation level is too weak, let me help you."
After saying that, he picked up the crystal clear inner elixir from Wang Xian's hand and stuffed it into his mouth.
Before Wang Xian could react, he picked up the jade cup and poured the spirit wine into his mouth.
Wang Xian screamed and felt a burning fire spreading in his chest.
The woman in white grabbed his little hand and said in a deep voice: "Gather your spiritual energy, and I will help you refine it..."
Wang Xian nodded, and a huge amount of spiritual power poured into his body in an instant.
"Ah..."
With a cry of surprise, Wang Xian couldn't bear the rolling spiritual energy at all.
title_en: Chapter 25: The refining of the truth is late Chapter 26: Brother looks at the gods
